title: ShortLink
description: plinth.short_link/1, from api.resolve_short_link(p_code): what a plinth.in/r/<code> link names -- a project's own short code (kind phase) or an issued share card's short code (kind card). Read-only; never increments the Live Record placement count that api.live_record (M4) owns.

slug.description: The phase's slug when kind is phase; null when kind is card.

card_code.description: The share card's short code when kind is card; null when kind is phase.
